title_en: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion and Free Update Arrive Next Week, Unlocking Underwater Gameplay
subtitle: 潜入新小镇
summary: 《宝可梦Pokopia》将在8月5日推出免费更新和首个付费扩展包Bubbly Basin。玩家可用玛纳霏带来的潜水能力探索水下、遇见新宝可梦；扩展通行证售价34.99美元。
opus_summary: 《宝可梦Pokopia》8月5日推出免费更新和付费扩展包Bubbly Basin。潜水能力让百变怪化身进入水下；扩展包新增区域、宝可梦、家具、巨牙鲨潜艇基地。

paragraphs.en: Pokémon Pokopia will unlock underwater gameplay next week as part of a free update, alongside the launch of the game's first expansion.
paragraphs.cn: 《宝可梦Pokopia》将在下周通过免费更新解锁水下玩法，同时推出游戏的首个扩展包。

paragraphs.en: On August 5, all players will gain the new Dive ability from a passing Manaphy, the Mythical water creature (that Pokémon Go seems to have forgotten exists). With Dive unlocked, you'll be able to summon up a bubble of air around your head — finally allowing your Ditto avatar the ability to survive for longer than a few seconds below the waves.
paragraphs.cn: 8月5日，所有玩家都将从一只路过的玛纳霏那里获得新能力「潜水」；这只水属性幻之宝可梦似乎已被《Pokémon GO》忘记它还存在。解锁潜水后，玩家可以在头部周围召唤空气泡，终于让百变怪化身能在海面下存活不止几秒钟。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, underwater gameplay will allow you to build beneath the sea just as you currently can on land. Meanwhile, your gathered Pokémon can swim along with you.
paragraphs.cn: 水下玩法确实会让玩家像现在在陆地上一样，在海底进行建造；与此同时，已收集的宝可梦也能和你一起游泳。

paragraphs.en: Take a deep breath and unwind as we go on a deep dive into the underwater town of Bubbly Basin. 🫧🤿 The #PokemonPokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC Part 1: Bubbly Basin releases August 5, 2026. pic.twitter.com/iJPgzteM0P
paragraphs.cn: 深吸一口气，放松下来，一起深入水下小镇Bubbly Basin。付费DLC《宝可梦Pokopia》扩展通行证第1部分：Bubbly Basin将于2026年8月5日发布。

paragraphs.en: All of this ties into the arrival of Pokopia's first paid expansion, Bubbly Basin, which will also become accessible on August 5 to anyone with the $34.99 Pokémon Pokopia expansion pass .
paragraphs.cn: 这些内容都与Pokopia首个付费扩展包Bubbly Basin的推出有关。持有售价为34.99美元(约合人民币237元)的《宝可梦Pokopia》扩展通行证的玩家，也将在8月5日获得该扩展包。

paragraphs.en: Most notably, this expansion adds the game's first post-launch region, the aforementioned Bubbly Basin, which features swathes of submerged land for you to flex your new Dive abilities. It's here you'll also meet Popplio, Mudkip, Corsola, Corphish and Chinchou, who'll teach you how to plant underwater grass, grow underwater watermelons, and power underwater electronic items (which sounds dangerous).
paragraphs.cn: 最值得一提的是，这个扩展包加入了游戏发售后的首个新区域，也就是前述的Bubbly Basin；那里有大片水下地带，供玩家施展新获得的潜水能力。玩家还会在此遇见球球海狮、水跃鱼、太阳珊瑚、龙虾小兵和灯笼鱼，它们会教你种植水下草坪、培育水下西瓜，以及为水下电子设备供能（听起来很危险）。

paragraphs.en: Other Bubbly Basin Pokémon spotted in today's trailer include Buizel, Lumineon, Stunfisk, Frillish, Carvanha, Sharpedo, Lantern, Totodile, Primarina, Golispod, and Dhelmise.
paragraphs.cn: 今日预告片中出现的其他Bubbly Basin宝可梦包括泳圈鼬、霓虹鱼、泥巴鱼、轻飘飘、利牙鱼、巨牙鲨、电灯怪、小锯鳄、西狮海壬、具甲武者和破破舵轮。

paragraphs.en: As you might expect, the expansion adds fresh items and furniture to collect, plus a Sharpedo submarine base. Finally, Bubbly Basin holds more secrets in its deepest depths: dark underwater caves illuminated only with neon coral.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，这个扩展包还会加入可收集的新物品和家具，以及一座巨牙鲨潜艇基地。最后，Bubbly Basin的最深处还藏着更多秘密：仅由霓虹珊瑚照亮的幽暗水下洞穴。

paragraphs.en: You can purchase the Pokémon Pokopia expansion pass now ahead of Bubbly Basin's launch next week. The pass also includes a second expansion due this year that will add accessories for your Pokémon to wear, and a third expansion due in 2027 that adds yet another town.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家现在就可在Bubbly Basin下周推出前购买《宝可梦Pokopia》扩展通行证。通行证还包含一部将在今年推出的第二扩展包，为宝可梦加入可穿戴饰品；以及一部将在2027年推出的第三扩展包，再加入一座小镇。
